text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًۭا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction linking the new communication rule to the prior discourse
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the prior discourse before the negated access rule begins. The communication taxonomy therefore enters as connected clarification of divine governance, not as a detached maxim.

topics.headline: resumptive bridge into the speech rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the communication law as a connected clarification of divine governance, not as an isolated maxim.
topics.reason: The conjunction precedes the negated frame and coherently resumes the prior attribute closure.

words.gloss_range: negation over the whole admissibility frame before the exception list opens

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: deficient verb that opens the negated admissibility frame
exceptive particle opening the allowed modes

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the whole {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) admissibility frame before any exception appears. It first bars unmediated human entitlement to divine speech, then the delayed {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) opens only the named modes.

topics.headline: negation of human entitlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denial targets unmediated human access as fittingness or entitlement, not divine inability to speak.
topics.reason: The negation governs the kāna frame and the lām-marked human predicate.

topics.headline: denial before allowed modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels unrestricted access close first, then watches the three authorized routes open under exception.
topics.reason: The mā ... illā construction licenses restriction by negation and exception.

words.gloss_range: settled deficient-verb frame denying unmediated access as human entitlement
words.root_gloss_range: state, occurrence, and fittingness; here narrowed to admissible human access in the negated rule

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: eligibility construction formed by the deficient verb and lām

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes the issue a settled rule of fittingness: what does or does not belong to human standing. The {{ar:كَانَ لِـ}} ({{tr:kāna li-}}) construction denies direct address as human entitlement, while 3:79 and the same-surah recurrence at 42:46 show a broader non-possession formula without changing this local access rule.

topics.headline: kāna li as denied eligibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees direct address framed as what belongs to human standing, not as a limit on the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The deficient verb plus lām predicate makes the human the denied holder of access.

topics.headline: settled access rule before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader processes ontology and admissible configuration before the speech verb, so mediation reads as structural rather than incidental.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I deficient verb opens a rule statement and precedes the speech complement.

topics.headline: non-possession formula across contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a wider Quranic denial-of-human-claim pattern: 3:79 denies one kind of human claim, and 42:46 and 42:51 reuse non-possession logic for rescue and direct speech.
topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete formula parallels without overriding the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: lām of fittingness and claim attached to the human receiver class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: eligibility construction governing the human receiver phrase

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) binds the denial directly to the human receiver class. In the {{ar:كَانَ لِـ}} ({{tr:kāna li-}}) frame it marks claim and fittingness, and its placement before the speech complement makes human standing frame the whole communication rule.

topics.headline: lām binds denied claim to human
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial attach to human claim or fittingness, not to the reality of divine speech itself.
topics.reason: The lām is fused to the human noun and functions in the kāna-li eligibility frame.

topics.headline: receiver status comes first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets human limitation before the speech act is named, so the whole rule is heard from the receiver side.
topics.reason: Word order places the lām phrase before the an-clause.

words.gloss_range: generic indefinite human receiver under negation, with embodied limitation foregrounded
words.root_gloss_range: human embodiment and visible creatureliness, with direct-contact derivatives only as contrastive pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: commissioned messenger role contrasted with bare human status

words.prose: {{ar:بَشَرٍ}} ({{tr:basharin}}) is an indefinite singular under negation, so one grammatical human stands for the whole receiver class. Its embodied, skin-visible field makes the limitation creaturely rather than divine: bare humanity is not the same as the commissioned {{ar:رَسُولًۭا}} ({{tr:rasūlan}}) role, and 18:110 helps show why revelation, not bare bashar-status, authorizes access.

topics.headline: indefinite human under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears no single human exception hiding in the grammar; the indefinite singular represents the whole receiver class.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness and singular generic use under negation generalize the rule.

topics.headline: skin-bearing humanity and controlled contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the receiver is creaturely and exposed, so mediation protects finite embodiment from unbounded direct address.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is valid as semantic color while local syntax keeps bashar as the generic human noun.

topics.headline: human class contrasted with envoy role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish bare humanity from authorized messenger function; 18:110 pairs bashar-status with revelation, while 42:51 explains why revelation is the access channel.
topics.reason: The local order and rasūl contrast support the distinction, and the intertext rows supply compatible parallels.

words.gloss_range: subordinator embedding the speech act as the denied content of the access frame
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) embeds the following speech act inside the denied access frame. The ayah restricts the event of Allah speaking to a human as a whole, then lets the exception list answer how that act can occur lawfully.

topics.headline: speech act embedded as content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah restricts the whole event of Allah speaking to a human, not a freestanding statement.
topics.reason: The complementizer governs the following verb clause inside the mā kāna frame.

topics.headline: act named before modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears the restricted act, then each exception answers how that act can occur lawfully.
topics.reason: The an-clause precedes illā and the three alternatives.

words.gloss_range: Form II directed-address verb with the human object suffix retained inside the denial
words.root_gloss_range: speech, marking, and wound-impact; here selected as directed divine address to a receiver

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first revelation mode answering the direct speech verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُكَلِّمَهُ}} ({{tr:yukallimahu}}) names directed address, with the suffix keeping the human receiver grammatically present. The k-l-m mark-impact pressure makes divine speech feel weighty enough to need regulated channels, and the sequence then reclassifies direct address through {{ar:وَحْيًا}} ({{tr:waḥyan}}) and the other modes; 4:164 remains real divine speech but is classified by this rule.

topics.headline: Form II address keeps receiver present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a personal address relation, with the human still grammatically present as object, rather than vague information transfer.
topics.reason: The object suffix points back to bashar and Form II selects directed address.

topics.headline: speech root carries mark-impact pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine speech as contact that leaves an effect, helping explain why its channels are immediately regulated.
topics.reason: The wound or mark branch is kept as semantic pressure but not made the local lexical sense.

topics.headline: direct speech pivots into mediated waḥy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the desired direct-address verb become the hinge into revelation and other authorized modes.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the speech verb immediately before the exception taxonomy and first waḥy mode.

topics.headline: known divine speech classified, not denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hold 4:164 and 42:24 with 42:51: divine speech is real, but this ayah classifies its access as exceptional and measured.
topics.reason: The parallels are concrete and compatible with the local rule.

words.gloss_range: delayed nominative proper name identifying the divine speaker and later permission source
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, and awe; local grammar selects the proper divine name as speaker

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: permission phrase that returns agency to the divine speaker

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) appears after the object-marked verb, naming the speaker only once human reception has been framed. The same divine agency then returns in {{ar:بِإِذْنِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-idhnihi}}), so speech, permission, and the closing attributes belong to one agent; 7:143 becomes a narrated case under this regulated access rule.

topics.headline: named speaker after human receiver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine agent named only after the human receiver is framed, sharpening the contrast between unrestricted agency and restricted reception.
topics.reason: The nominative proper name follows the object-marked verb and stands before the exception.

topics.headline: same agent governs speech and permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can trace one divine agency from prior pronoun to named speaker to the later permission suffix.
topics.reason: Referent and sequence evidence keep the permission phrase tied to the named speaker.

topics.headline: proper name carries worship-awe into access rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears regulated access to the worshipped divine subject, with 7:143 functioning as a narrated case of rule-bound address.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute remains background and the Moses parallel does not replace the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: exceptive particle converting total denial into a restricted taxonomy of allowed modes

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation particle paired with the exception
disjunctive particle repeated in the exception list

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) turns broad denial into a restricted allowance. With the earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and the repeated {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}), it builds a closed taxonomy: hidden revelation, screened address, or messenger dispatch.

topics.headline: exception turns denial into taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mediation as the only valid remainder after ordinary direct access is excluded: hidden revelation, screened address, or messenger dispatch.
topics.reason: The exceptive particle works with prior negation and repeated disjunction to create a closed access taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun naming hidden revelation as the first mode of divine speech
words.root_gloss_range: swift hidden disclosure and nonordinary signaling; here the first authorized speech mode

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later revelation verb that reprises the first mode root

words.prose: {{ar:وَحْيًا}} ({{tr:waḥyan}}) is the first allowed mode and works as manner of divine speech, not a separate object beside it. Its w-ḥ-y field gives real disclosure without ordinary face-to-face exchange, and its later return in {{ar:يُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:yūḥiya}}) keeps messenger relay within revelation; 53:4 and the Surah 42 waḥy thread sharpen that link.

topics.headline: waḥy names manner before medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that revelation is first a mode of divine speech, not merely an object or later messenger product.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun functions modally and begins the exception list.

topics.headline: hidden signaling rather than conversation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears real disclosure without ordinary face-to-face exchange, preserving access while denying conversational directness.
topics.reason: The root field supports swift hidden signaling and the local contrast with the speech verb selects that pressure.

topics.headline: first and third modes share revelation vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects 53:4 and the Surah 42 waḥy thread to this taxonomy: messenger delivery remains revelation, not a rival category.
topics.reason: The intertext and local recurrence rows support a waḥy thread while local syntax keeps this word as the first mode.

words.gloss_range: first disjunctive particle separating hidden disclosure from screened encounter
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) separates the first mode from the screened phrase while keeping both inside one exception frame. The disjunction lets unlike syntax carry real alternatives, and the repeated sound-beat makes the branching list audible.

topics.headline: first disjunction separates signal and screen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears revelation and screened speech as distinct authorized routes even though their syntax differs.
topics.reason: The first aw coordinates unlike phrase types inside one exception frame.

topics.headline: repeated aw makes branching audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the taxonomy branch in two short repeated beats before the second and third modes.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a concrete audible payoff that matches the visible list structure.

words.gloss_range: source preposition opening the second mode as speech from beyond a barrier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first mode contrasted with screened speech

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) opens the screened mode as speech from beyond a barrier. It preserves connection to the receiver while marking distance, so the screen is a distinct channel rather than a modifier of {{ar:وَحْيًا}} ({{tr:waḥyan}}).

topics.headline: source relation across distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees screened speech as connected relation from beyond a barrier, not silence or absence.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the far-side barrier phrase with source force.

topics.headline: preposition opens the barrier mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not fold the screen into waḥy; the preposition starts a distinct channel of bounded access.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is coordinated as the second exception.

words.gloss_range: construct noun/adverbial forming the screened far-side location with the barrier noun
words.root_gloss_range: concealment and beyondness from a viewpoint; here a screened source-position

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: barrier noun completing the construct phrase

words.prose: {{ar:وَرَآئِ}} ({{tr:warāʾi}}) forms a construct with {{ar:حِجَابٍ}} ({{tr:ḥijābin}}), compressing far-side location and barrier into one screened-source expression. The beyondness is viewer-relative and concealed, so it marks human perceptual limitation without localizing Allah; 33:53 gives a protected-access phrase parallel. Its position between hidden disclosure and envoy dispatch makes it the middle protected encounter, and the word-edge audibly delays arrival at the barrier.

topics.headline: far-side location and barrier compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees location and screen fused into one protected-source expression: access comes from the far side, not by removing the barrier.
topics.reason: Construct attachment and adverbial noun use support the screened-source relation.

topics.headline: concealed beyondness from human viewpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes human perceptual limitation without imagining Allah confined in ordinary space.
topics.reason: The root family and warāʾ semantics are narrowed by the local barrier phrase and later transcendence closure.

topics.headline: protected access phrase reused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 33:53 protected access with 42:51, where the phrase-shape is applied to divine communication itself.
topics.reason: The concrete parallel supports phrase-level resonance without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: middle mode pauses before the screen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the screened phrase as the middle protected encounter between hidden disclosure and envoy dispatch, with the word-edge audibly delaying arrival at the barrier.
topics.reason: The sequence and phonetic row offer a local payoff within the taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: indefinite barrier noun naming screened access as a general mode, not one curtain
words.root_gloss_range: veiling, blocking, and access control; here a barrier that permits relation while preserving separation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant that layers the barrier image

words.prose: {{ar:حِجَابٍ}} ({{tr:ḥijābin}}) completes the second mode as a general barrier, not one named curtain. The ḥ-j-b field makes it access control that permits relation while blocking unregulated visibility; the {{ar:حُجُبٍ}} ({{tr:ḥujubin}}) variant and rare root field thicken the screen image, while 17:45, 33:53, and 38:32 keep it inside a wider veil formula, and its indefinite ending audibly anticipates the wise closure.

topics.headline: barrier as access control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the screen as a general mode that permits relation while denying unregulated visibility or entry.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun and root field make barrier-access the second mode rather than one material curtain.

topics.headline: variant and rarity thicken the screen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the barrier image is marked and layered; the variant plural-like reading thickens mediation without changing the root force.
topics.reason: Accepted variant and sparse-root evidence enrich the barrier image while the base form remains local.

topics.headline: screen formula tied to perception and wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can link 17:45, 33:53, and 38:32 screen contexts with 42:51, while the ending sound anticipates the wise closure.
topics.reason: The cross-references are concrete and the phonetic row coheres with the closing attribute.

words.gloss_range: second disjunctive particle introducing the commissioned messenger clause as a third mode
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) introduces the third option with a finite dispatch clause. It keeps messenger mediation from being merely an explanation of the screen phrase and shifts the taxonomy from protected location to commissioned transmission.

topics.headline: third option with new syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears messenger dispatch as a third authorized route, not as an explanation of the screen phrase.
topics.reason: The second aw coordinates a finite clause after nominal and prepositional modes.

topics.headline: branch from barrier to envoy mediation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the taxonomy shift from protected location to enacted commissioned transmission.
topics.reason: The repeated aw pattern marks the three alternatives as branches of one rule.

words.gloss_range: Form IV subjunctive dispatch verb naming messenger-sending as authorized communication route
words.root_gloss_range: sending, release, and commission; here controlled divine dispatch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: object of dispatch defining the sent envoy

words.prose: {{ar:يُرْسِلَ}} ({{tr:yursila}}) makes the third mode a controlled divine dispatch. Form IV and the repeated r-s-l with {{ar:رَسُولًۭا}} ({{tr:rasūlan}}) define the envoy by being sent; the accepted indicative reading can make the channel sound like asserted divine practice, while the base reading keeps it governed by the exception. The sequence is commission first, disclosure second, with 14:4 clarifying messenger delivery.

topics.headline: controlled dispatch, not self-access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the envoy enter by divine commissioning, not by human approach or self-appointment.
topics.reason: The subjunctive remains inside the exception and Form IV encodes controlled dispatch.

topics.headline: variant asserts the channel dynamically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the accepted raised reading as making the messenger channel an asserted divine practice while the base reading keeps it governed by the exception.
topics.reason: The variant is valid contrast evidence but does not replace the base local dependency.

topics.headline: commission first, disclosure second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-step protocol: the sent one is defined by sending, then disclosure follows through that commissioned route, with 14:4 clarifying messenger delivery.
topics.reason: Local sequencing and repeated root evidence support the protocol; the intertext is compatible.

words.gloss_range: indefinite envoy noun naming a role class whose authority derives from being sent
words.root_gloss_range: sentness and commissioned authority; here the envoy role defined by being sent
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولًۭا}} ({{tr:rasūlan}}) is an indefinite object naming a role class, not one historical envoy. Its authority is derivative from the sender, then the chain immediately bounds delivery by permission; 26:192-194 shows trusted-carrier relay as revelation, not ordinary reporting.

topics.headline: envoy role defined by sentness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an authorized role class whose authority comes from the sender before any delivery occurs.
topics.reason: The indefinite object and noun pattern make the envoy a commissioned role, not one autonomous source.

topics.headline: trusted-carrier relay as speech mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects 26:192-194 with this messenger mode: carrier activity is revelatory transmission, not ordinary social reporting.
topics.reason: The r-s-l and w-ḥ-y field plus concrete reference support the relay reading.

topics.headline: sentness is audible and permission-bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the envoy is completed as a commissioned object before disclosure, then immediately bounded by permission.
topics.reason: Sequence, permission adjacency, and sound recurrence all reinforce derivative authority.

words.gloss_range: close-sequence particle binding messenger dispatch to the following revelation act

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: revelation verb bound to dispatch by fa

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds the sending clause to {{ar:يُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:yūḥiya}}) as immediate consequence. The third mode is therefore a close protocol: an envoy is commissioned, then revelation proceeds through that authorized channel.

topics.headline: fa binds sending to revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the third mode as a compressed protocol: commission first, disclosure as its immediate consequence.
topics.reason: The close-sequence particle attaches the revelation verb to the dispatch clause and supports result force.

words.gloss_range: Form IV revelation verb in the relay clause, permission-bound and content-bound by will
words.root_gloss_range: caused revelation and hidden disclosure; here relay remains revelation under permission and will

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: authorization phrase governing the relay verb
will clause selecting the revealed payload
first revelation mode echoed by the relay verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:yūḥiya}}) can grammatically foreground the envoy's relay, but {{ar:بِإِذْنِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-idhnihi}}) and {{ar:مَا يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:mā yashāʾu}}) keep agency and content anchored in Allah. The recipient recedes while payload remains open until will defines it, and the return from {{ar:وَحْيًا}} ({{tr:waḥyan}}) shows that messenger relay remains waḥy; 28:7 confirms the wider disclosure range.

topics.headline: recoverable subject under divine authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can allow messenger relay grammatically while still seeing agency controlled by permission and will.
topics.reason: Subject recovery and the indicative variant are kept inside the authorization structure.

topics.headline: recipient recedes while payload is selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recipient identity is not the focus; the revealed content stays open until divine will defines it.
topics.reason: The object is relative mā and the recipient is omitted, foregrounding selected content.

topics.headline: messenger relay remains waḥy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the third channel as revelation under authority, not a messenger producing independent interpretation; 28:7 confirms the wider waḥy range.
topics.reason: Form IV, permission adjacency, and recurrence from waḥyan to yūḥiya support this.

words.gloss_range: instrumental/authorization preposition attaching permission directly to revelation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: revelation verb immediately followed by authorization

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns permission into the operative license for the revelation verb. Because it follows {{ar:يُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:yūḥiya}}) immediately, the messenger channel cannot be heard as self-authorized.

topics.headline: bi makes permission operative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees permission as the license through which revelation occurs, cutting off any autonomous messenger agency.
topics.reason: The preposition is attached immediately after the revelation verb and governs the permission noun.

words.gloss_range: possessed verbal noun of permission, making authorization divine-owned and governing
words.root_gloss_range: permission, notice, and hearing; here authorization as the governing condition of relay

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the permission noun
closing wisdom attribute grounding permission
payload clause following the permission phrase

words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِهِۦ}} ({{tr:idhnihi}}) makes authorization divine-owned through its suffix. As a verbal noun governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), permission becomes the condition for the act before {{ar:مَا يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:mā yashāʾu}}) names the payload; the root's notice-and-hearing side keeps this from being bare allowance, making it a licensed communicative opening. 42:21 reverses forbidden invention into licensed revelation, 2:255 parallels controlled access, and {{ar:حَكِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ḥakīmun}}) grounds permission in wisdom.

topics.headline: possessive suffix returns authority to Allah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the permission back to the divine speaker even if the messenger is the nearest relay subject.
topics.reason: Referent evidence and the possessive suffix point to the same divine agency.

topics.headline: permission governs act before payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees authorization of the act placed before selection of content, so relay is licensed before it is specified.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the revelation verb and the verbal noun abstracts permission as a condition.

topics.headline: permission as communicative opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears permission not as bare allowance only, but as a licensed communicative opening.
topics.reason: The root joins notice, hearing, and leave; local grammar selects authorization as the governing sense.

topics.headline: forbidden invention reversed into licensed revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 42:21 and 2:255 with 42:51: permission blocks unauthorized claims and also licenses true revelatory access, then wisdom grounds the license.
topics.reason: The cross-references are concrete and the wisdom link is locally supported by the closing attribute.

words.gloss_range: relative object pronoun leaving payload open until specified by divine will

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: will verb completing the relative payload

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the revealed payload but leaves it open until {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) completes the relative clause. After permission has licensed the act, this open object delays message specifics so content belongs to divine selection rather than envoy or receiver initiative.

topics.headline: open payload awaits will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the content left deliberately open except for the will clause, denying independent message range to envoy or receiver.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is object of yūḥiya and is completed by the following verb.

topics.headline: authority before message specifics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah prioritizes authorization and selection before any message details.
topics.reason: The sequence places permission before the open object and will clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect will verb closing the payload as whatever He wills
words.root_gloss_range: will and determinate thinghood; here content becomes determinate by divine volition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: permission phrase paired with will as an act boundary

words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) closes the payload as whatever He wills. The imperfect presents active governance of selection, and together with {{ar:بِإِذْنِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-idhnihi}}) it forms a double boundary: permission controls the act, will controls the content; 2:255 and 42:52 extend the same boundary logic around knowledge and continuing revelation.

topics.headline: will closes the content range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees revealed content become only what He wills, with no surplus payload for messenger initiative or recipient desire.
topics.reason: The imperfect relative clause completes mā and presents active governance of selection.

topics.headline: permission controls act, will controls content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a double boundary around relay, comparable to 2:255 knowledge limits and continuing into the 42:52 revelation thread.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels and the local sequence supports the act/content distinction.

words.gloss_range: emphatic resumptive pronoun clause grounding the taxonomy in divine attributes
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) gathers the whole rule back to Allah as explanatory subject. The final nominal clause grounds the three-channel taxonomy in divine attributes, and the pronoun bookends the named speaker with the closing seal while echoing the adjacent attribute seal across the 42:50-42:51 boundary.

topics.headline: inna grounds the taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the three-mode rule grounded in who Allah is, not left as a bare procedure.
topics.reason: The inna clause resumes the divine subject and opens the closing predicates.

topics.headline: pronoun seals agency across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the named speaker back into the closing pronoun and across the adjacent attribute seal.
topics.reason: Referent evidence ties the pronoun to the explicit divine name and the boundary row is coherent.

words.gloss_range: first closing predicate, naming exalted transcendence as the ground of mediated access
words.root_gloss_range: height, superiority, and transcendence; here rank and exaltedness rather than spatial confinement
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِىٌّ}} ({{tr:ʿaliyyun}}) is the first closing predicate, so transcendence first explains why direct exposure is unfitting. The height field names rank and exaltedness rather than spatial confinement behind the screen, and 2:255 shows the same exalted sovereignty applied here to regulated communication access.

topics.headline: transcendence first grounds access limits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mediated speech explained first by divine exaltedness before wisdom names the measured channels.
topics.reason: The word is the first nominative predicate in the closing attribute pair.

topics.headline: height field protects against spatializing the screen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the veil as protected transcendence and rank, not as Allah being located behind a physical screen.
topics.reason: The root dispute, faʿīl form, and veil resonance preserve exaltedness while local theology blocks spatial confinement.

topics.headline: sovereign height applied to communication access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 2:255 exalted sovereignty with 42:51 regulated communication, while the boundary shifts from outcomes to access.
topics.reason: The concrete intertext and boundary row support the domain shift.

words.gloss_range: second closing predicate, naming wise measured governance as the ground of the access taxonomy
words.root_gloss_range: judgment, restraint, firmness, and wisdom; here measured governance of communication access

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: will clause answered by the wisdom predicate

words.prose: {{ar:حَكِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ḥakīmun}}) completes the attribute pair by adding measured governance to exaltedness. Its ḥ-k-m field turns the three modes into wise architecture rather than arbitrary withholding, and it answers {{ar:مَا يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:mā yashāʾu}}): willed content is measured by wisdom, with 6:18 and the Surah 42 governance thread reinforcing that closure.

topics.headline: wisdom balances transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears mediated distance completed by measured governance, so transcendence does not sound like remoteness.
topics.reason: The word is the second predicate after innahu and pairs with the prior title.

topics.headline: limits become wise architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the three modes as ordered wisdom rather than arbitrary withholding or a loose catalog.
topics.reason: The root field and faʿīl pattern support stable measured governance of the taxonomy.

topics.headline: willed content interpreted through wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects 6:18 and the Surah 42 governance thread: what He wills to disclose is measured by wisdom.
topics.reason: The local sequence from will to wisdom and the concrete references support the closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: yukallimahu, the three illa/aw routes, bi-idhnihi, and ma yasha
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception series partitions divine-human communication into hidden delivery, screened address, and a dispatched carrier; permission and will keep source, channel, and content under one authority.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech connecting speakers establishes the relation being channelled.
Hidden conveyance supplies both the first route and the messenger's relayed act.
An interposed screen distinguishes mediated address from unbounded direct contact.
A message and its carrier form the third communicative interface.
Permission makes the relay authorized rather than self-originating.
Will governs what the authorized channel conveys.

changed_reading.before: A general denial followed by miscellaneous exceptions.
changed_reading.after: A controlled interface taxonomy in which channel, carrier, authorization, and content remain distinct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: li-basharin, min wara'i hijabin, and aliyyun
baseline_models.mechanism: The visibly surfaced human receiver stands on one side of a concealed boundary while the source retains hierarchical elevation; mediation crosses the boundary without erasing the asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: Visible skin and surface make the human the exposed receiving side of the relation.
The other side of a barrier supplies relational distance without requiring simple physical behindness.
Blocked access preserves the boundary that mediated communication traverses.
Rank and elevation close the verse by preserving source-receiver asymmetry.

changed_reading.before: The veil is only an obstacle to direct speech.
changed_reading.after: The veil marks an interface across unequal levels, allowing reception while preserving concealed otherness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wound branch of k-l-m beside hijab, idhn, and hakim
baseline_models.mechanism: If speech-contact can be imagined through the wound branch of k-l-m as incisive contact, screen, permission, and wise restraint become safeguards around an encounter rather than signs of communicative deficiency.

activation_trace.role: A bodily wound supplies the exploratory image of contact that leaves a mark.
Prevention of access functions as protection around potentially incisive contact.
Permission regulates when mediated contact may proceed.
Restraint that prevents harm for repair gives the restrictions a protective function.

changed_reading.before: Indirect modes are lesser substitutes for direct speech.
changed_reading.after: Indirect modes may be wise safeguards that make transformative contact receivable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early repetition of revelation to the present addressee and those before him turns the focus taxonomy into a recurring relay across recipients and times.

activation_trace.role: Divine inspiration and messenger-borne disclosure anchor the focus routes.
The same divine-disclosure branch explicitly recurs for the present recipient.
Temporal precedence extends that recurrence to earlier recipients.

structural_cues: 42:3 opens the rooted discourse with yuhī and closes with hakim, both repeated in 42:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated w-h-y and 'before you'; I infer continuity of one authorized relay across recipients, while the live alternative is a formulaic comparison without channel implications.

changed_reading.after: 42:51 codifies a recurrent divine mode that remains stable across changing human recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-splitting heavens under pressure from above, followed by angelic activity, activates the veil and messenger as a regulated boundary that bears communicative pressure.

activation_trace.role: The screening barrier supplies the load-bearing boundary in the focus.
The carrier supplies a controlled passage across that boundary.
Opening and splitting provide the packet's image of a boundary under strain.
Direction from above supplies the pressure orientation without fixing a literal divine location.
Angelic actors occupy the mediating zone immediately after the threatened split.

structural_cues: 42:5 places near-fracture from above beside angelic praise and intercession; 42:51 ends with aliyy and hakim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strained upper boundary and mediating angels; I infer that screen and messenger regulate what a finite receiver can bear, while the live alternative is that hijab only denotes concealment.

changed_reading.before: The three modes form a scale ranked mainly by directness.
changed_reading.after: The mediated modes function as load-managed interfaces that preserve both contact and the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere in the surah, word-language is joined to precedence, decisive separation, erasure of falsehood, and establishment of truth; divine speaking therefore carries performative force as well as information.

activation_trace.role: Speech between speakers anchors the performative extension in the focus verb.
A meaningful word is the object associated with an already operative precedence.
Precedence makes the cited word function before the delayed judgment.
Decisive separation gives the repeated word a judging operation.
Erasure supplies one world-changing effect associated with divine words.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the complementary constructive effect.

structural_cues: Kalima or kalimat recurs at 42:14, 42:21, and 42:24 in clauses governing judgment and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies words associated with prior force, separation, erasure, and truth-establishment; I transfer that performative capacity to yukallimahu, while the live alternative keeps decree-language distinct from communicative speech.

changed_reading.before: God's speaking primarily transfers propositions to a human.
changed_reading.after: Authorized divine speech can also enact delay, distinction, removal, and establishment in its recipient world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's rejection of prescriptions not authorized by God makes bi-idhnihi a provenance boundary: a carrier's relay counts as divine communication only under source authorization.

activation_trace.role: Permission explicitly authenticates the messenger's act in the focus.
Negated authorization supplies the contrast case of an invalidly sourced prescription.
Entering and instituting an affair shows the unauthorized output becoming operative.
Decisive judgment preserves the distinction between authorized and rival claims.

structural_cues: 42:21 pairs lam ya'dhan bihi Allah with rival prescription; 42:51 pairs bi-idhnihi with the messenger's relay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative authorization test and a positive messenger authorization; I infer source authentication, while the live alternative limits 42:21 to law rather than communication.

changed_reading.before: By His permission is ceremonial assent after a messenger is chosen.
changed_reading.after: By His permission is the provenance control that prevents mediated speech from acquiring an independent source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close formula yunzilu bi-qadarin ma yasha maps will onto measured descent, revising the focus so ma yasha governs dose, timing, and form of communication, not content alone.

activation_trace.role: Will governs what passes through the authorized focus channel.
Expansion and abundance establish the danger of an unmeasured allotment.
Measured provision is delivered downward, supplying an analogy for controlled delivery.
A bounded amount supplies the calibrating mechanism.
The matching will formula directly joins chosen measure to delivery.

structural_cues: 42:27 states yunzilu bi-qadarin ma yasha; 42:51 states fa-yuhi bi-idhnihi ma yasha.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching delivery, measure, and will syntax; I infer that revelation too is receiver-fitted allotment, while the live alternative treats the match as a general sovereignty formula.

changed_reading.before: Ma yasha selects only the message's propositional content.
changed_reading.after: Ma yasha selects a measured communicative dose, timing, and interface fitted to the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sent addressee in 42:48 is explicitly denied guardianship and assigned only delivery, sharpening the focus messenger as a carrier whose authority and content remain upstream.

activation_trace.role: The focus names both the message relation and its carrier.
Being dispatched supplies the parallel sent-agent relation.
Negated guardianship removes control over recipients from the sent agent.
Delivery of the message positively defines the agent's limited function.

structural_cues: 42:48 contrasts ma arsalnaka ... hafizan with illa al-balag immediately before the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, denied guardianship, and delivery; I infer a carrier-not-controller rule for 42:51, while the live alternative distinguishes the human envoy in 42:48 from the messenger in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is simply one of three ways God speaks.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is a bounded relay: sent and effective in delivery, but neither source nor controller of reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding distribution of offspring and barrenness frames human configurations as bestowed under will; the focus then treats communicative receptivity likewise as configured access rather than a native human entitlement.

activation_trace.role: The human species term anchors the shift from generated embodiment to communicative capacity.
Will governs the content and route available to the human receiver.
Gift without exchange supplies the model of capacities that cannot be claimed as entitlement.
Repeated will governs differentiated bestowal immediately before the focus.
Blocked generative receptivity supplies the contrast that makes access contingent rather than inherent.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 repeat yasha across gifted offspring and barrenness; 42:51 immediately repeats ma yasha after naming bashar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent bestowed and blocked human generativity under repeated will; I infer an analogy to bestowed communicative receptivity, while the live alternative treats 42:51 as a clean topical transition.

changed_reading.before: A human naturally has direct-access capacity that is merely restricted.
changed_reading.after: Human receptivity itself is bestowed and configured, so access arrives only in the mode granted to the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies the disclosed medium as spirit from the command, then light and guidance to a straight path; the focus channels therefore deliver an effect that animates, makes knowable, and directs.

activation_trace.role: Divine disclosure anchors the transition into the next ayah.
The repeated disclosure verb carries the focus mechanism directly forward.
Life-bearing spirit supplies an animating effect of the disclosure.
The originating command keeps the disclosed medium tied to its source.
Illumination turns hidden transfer into perceptible understanding.
Gentle direction converts received disclosure into guided movement.
The straight path gives that directional effect a traversable outcome.

structural_cues: 42:52 immediately repeats awhayna after 42:51 and moves from prior non-knowing to light and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spirit, command, light, guidance, and path as predicates or effects around repeated revelation; I infer a life-giving epistemic transformation, while the live alternative treats them as descriptions of one revealed object rather than every channel.

changed_reading.before: The channels terminate when a message reaches a human.
changed_reading.after: Authorized transfer culminates in animation, illumination, and directed movement within the receiver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a judgment-scene's hidden sidelong glance onto communication; it remains anchored in hijab's eye-shading and edge imagery plus wara's other side, but downstream prose should present it only as an optical analogy, not a physical description of divine speech.

activation_trace.role: The other side of a barrier supplies concealed relational depth.
An eyebrow that shields the eye supplies a filtering rather than wholly opaque barrier.
An edge or extremity supplies the narrow aperture of partial reception.
Hiddenness keeps the oblique glimpse within concealment.

changed_reading.before: A veil is an opaque wall that only subtracts directness.
changed_reading.after: A veil may function like a controlled aperture, permitting partial reception while preserving concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates aqim's obscure or barren-speech image from the preceding ayah; it remains anchored in yukallimahu and wahi and is worth retaining as a contrast between blocked and effect-bearing communication, but downstream prose should label it a lexical counter-image rather than a translation.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech supplies the focus-side contrast to communicative barrenness.
Hidden conveyance still reaches another and therefore bears communicative effect.
Obscure barren speech supplies the immediately adjacent negative counter-image.

changed_reading.before: The listed channels are neutral alternatives for moving speech.
changed_reading.after: Authorized mediation is effect-bearing speech, contrasted exploratorily with utterance whose channel is closed or barren.

strongest_changes: Permission became a provenance boundary rather than ceremonial assent.
Repeated kalima and kalimat contexts made divine speaking performative as well as informative.
The 42:27 syntax made will govern measured dose, timing, and interface.
42:48 and 42:52 separated carrier from controller and supplied illumination and guidance as communicative effects.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed exact verbal echoes around authorization, measure, delivery, and immediate sequence; it also preserved the stranger protective, aperture, and barren-speech activations without forcing them into the strongest model.
remaining_uncertainties: The pressure-regulating veil depends on transferring the near-splitting image of 42:5 to the focus boundary.
The bestowed-receptivity model depends on treating 42:49-50 as a framing sequence rather than a completed topic.
The performative force of kalima and kalimat may not transfer fully to the interpersonal form yukallimahu.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Divine speech reaches humans through three non-equivalent interfaces.** Lexical evidence: ك ل م `B001` (meaningful speech exchanged), و ح ي `B001` (hidden imparting), ر س ل `B001`/`B002` (sending/messenger), and ء ذ ن `B004` (authorization). Structural cue and role: the three **إِلَّا ... أَوْ ... أَوْ** channels preserve direct hidden imparting, screened address, and authorized messenger-mediated imparting. Abductive move: I infer that common origin does not collapse their distinct mediation structures. Reading change: revelation remains plural in mode while unified in authorization.

2. **The screen blocks access without blocking communication.** Lexical evidence: و ر ي `B005` (putting out of sight) and `B006` (far side/beyond), ح ج ب `B001` (blocking access), `B002` (screening veil), and `B004` (inner partition). Structural cue and role: **مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ** locates speech across a boundary rather than replacing it. Abductive move: I infer that concealment regulates encounter, while meaningful exchange still crosses the partition. Reading change: transcendence is mediated permeability, not silence.

3. **Highness and wisdom explain the channel constraints.** Lexical evidence: ع ل و `B001`/`B002` (height/rank), ح ك م `B003` (rightly guided knowledge), and `B004` (firm decisiveness). Structural cue and role: the final attributes follow the channel inventory. Abductive move: I infer that elevated asymmetry requires mediation and wisdom selects its apt form. Reading change: communication limits are purposeful architecture rather than communicative deficiency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:52 immediately instantiates the authorized revelation channel and shows its received object as **رُوحًا**. The later ayah therefore turns this modality inventory into an experienced transmission without collapsing the other modes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The boundary enables controlled contact through three interfaces.** **Lexical evidence:** ك ل م `B001` (meaningful speech exchanged with an interlocutor), و ح ي `B001` (hidden imparting), ح ج ب `B002` (screening veil) with `B001` (blocking access), and ر س ل `B002` (messenger and message). **Structural cue:** the ayah enumerates hidden imparting, speech from beyond a screen, and a sent messenger; 42:48 had distinguished conveyance from custody, and 42:52 describes the transmitted effect as spirit and light. **Assigned role:** the veil blocks unmediated access but creates a stable separation across which specified forms of contact can operate. **Abductive move:** I infer that boundary and communication are mutually enabling here rather than simple opposites. **Reading change:** حِجَابٍ is not only deprivation; it is one architecture of permitted speech across radical asymmetry.
2. **"Beyond" marks the far side of a barrier, not absence.** **Lexical evidence:** و ر ي `B006` (the far side: behind, ahead, or beyond) in وَرَآئِ, ح ج ب `B002`, and ء ذ ن `B004` (permission and authorization) in بِإِذْنِهِۦ. **Structural cue:** each communicative route preserves authorization, and the closing titles combine highness with restraining wisdom; 42:52 then shows that the message genuinely reaches and guides. **Assigned role:** وراء locates the source across a boundary, while permission controls what crosses it. **Abductive move:** I infer regulated transmission rather than spatial remoteness alone. **Reading change:** transcendence does not cancel communication; it determines its interfaces and permissions.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:52 demonstrated the efficacy of mediated speech: what crosses the boundary becomes spirit, light, and guidance. 42:53 then confirmed that authorized transmission reaches into the road by which all affairs converge.

baseline.text: Allah'ın bir insanla konuşması ancak vahiy yoluyla, bir perdenin ardından ya da bir elçi gönderip izniyle dilediğini vahyetmesiyle olur. Çünkü O yücedir, hüküm sahibidir.

findings.text: İlahi konuşma, ortak kaynağı korurken gizli aktarım, perde arkasından hitap ve yetkili elçi aracılığı olmak üzere birbirine indirgenemeyen üç arayüz kullanır.
Perde iletişimi yok etmez; erişimi sınırlar, kaynağı karşı tarafta tutar ve anlamlı sözün denetimli biçimde sınırı aşmasını sağlar.

Dönüşlü bağlı biçim de aynı şekilde birine güvence olmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu dalı bir kişi için güvence ve sorumluluk üstlenme anlamında birleştirir. Ad biçimi, üzerine alma sözü ve dönüşlü bağlı biçim aynı çekirdeğin ayrı anlatımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi adına sorumluluk alma çekirdeğini kısa ve açık biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Sorumluluk alma ve güvence olma yönlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin sorumluluğunu üzerine alma anlatımında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sorumluluk alma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Açık güvence verme tonunu tek başına göstermeyebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkası için güvence olma yönü öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güvence olma yönünü açıkça korur.

error_profile.collision: B001 ile karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan derisinin görünen dış bölümünü doğrudan verir; toprakla kurulan yapılarda ise toprağın üzerinde beliren bitkiyi aynı görünürlük bağıyla buna ekler. branches.source_phrase_ar: البشرة ظاهر جلد الإنسان (maqayis;sihah;mufradat)؛ البشرة أعلى جلد الوجه والجسد (ayn;tahdhib)؛ بشرة الأرض ما ظهر من نباتها وأبشرت الأرض إذا أخرجت نباتها (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı insan, insanlar ya da insan topluluğu olarak açıkça tanımlar ve kullanımın tekil-çoğul ile kadın-erkek ayrımını aşabildiğini gösterir. Görünen deri, adlandırmanın açıklaması olabilir; dalın gönderimi doğrudan insandır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, dış deri yüzünü ya da yüz güzelliğini değil, tek bir insanı veya topluca insanları adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal çıplak biçimde insanı veya insan topluluğunu adlandırır; komşu yapılara ait deri, haber ya da temas anlamları bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Cinsiyet ve sayı bakımından sınırlanmaksızın tek bir insanı, insanları ya da topluca insanlığı adlandırır.

facets.statement: Tekil veya toplu, kadın veya erkek ayrımı yapmadan insanı adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, biçimin hem tek bir insan hem de insanlar için kullanılabildiğinde ve cinsiyet ayrımı taşımadığında birleşir; görünür deri bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tek bir kişiyi, bir insan topluluğunu veya insan türünü sayı ve cinsiyet belirtmeden karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tekil insan ile toplu insanlık kapsamını ve cinsiyet yansızlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir kişi ya da sayı belirtilmeyen insan kavramı kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan gönderimini cinsiyet belirtmeden doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların tümü veya insan türü topluca kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Toplu insan ve insan türü gönderimini bağlama uygun biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir insanı veya insanlığı görünür bedenli oluş üzerinden adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanı yabanıllık ve görünmeyen varlıkların karşıtı olarak kurar; ayrıca bir yerde bulunan kimse anlamına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanı tekil veya toplu olarak gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan insan adlandırmasıdır; komşu dal insanı karşıt bir varlık alanı ve beraber bulunma düşüncesi içinde sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir insanı da, yalnızca insanlardan oluşan topluluğu da gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yeryüzündeki yaratılmışların tümüne uzanabilir ve bazı yorumlarda insanlarla görünmeyen varlıkları birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın topluluk kullanımları insanları topluca gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca insan gönderimlidir; komşu dalın kapsamı bütün yaratılmışlara veya insan dışındaki varlıklara açılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan türünü topluca ve cinsiyet belirtmeden adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bireyi kadın ya da erkek olarak adlandıran cinsiyetli biçimleri öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da tek bir insan bireyine gönderimde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tekil ile toplu ve kadın ile erkek arasında ayrım yapmaz; komşu dal bireysel ve cinsiyetli adlandırmaları merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; insan gönderiminin kapsamı, tür sınırı ve cinsiyet ayrımı bakımından en açıklayıcı üç yakın komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البشر بمعنى الإنسان أو الخلق، للواحد والجمع والذكر والأنثى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه حسن الوجه ولا البشارة ولا مجرد ظاهر الجلد إذا لم يرد به الإنسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وسمى البشر بشرا لظهورهم (maqayis)؛ البشر الإنسان الواحد رجلا كان أو امرأة (ayn)؛ البشر اسم يقع على الناس (jamhara)؛ البشر الخلق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ عبر عن الإنسان بالبشر اعتبارا بظهور جلده (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki yapı türünü açıkça birlikte verir: kadınla tenlerin değdiği doğrudan bedensel temas ve bir işin başında bizzat bulunup onu kendisinin yürütmesi. Ortak nokta aracısız ve kişisel katılımdır; iki yapı kendi sınırları içinde ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kadınla ilgili kullanım doğrudan bedensel teması, işle ilgili kullanım ise kişisel hazır bulunuş ve yürütmeyi gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca kadınla doğrudan bedensel temas ve bir işi bizzat üstlenme yapılarında belirlenir; çıplak köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda, iki kişinin tenlerinin değmesi yoluyla doğrudan bedensel yakınlaşmayı anlatır. Bir iş söz konusu olduğunda ise o işin başında bizzat bulunup onu kendisi yürütmeyi belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, aracı olmadan kendi bedeniyle ya da şahsen doğrudan katılır.
Kadınla ilgili yapılarda tenlerin değdiği yakın veya cinsel teması anlatır.
İşle ilgili yapıda, kişinin işin başında bulunmasını ve onu kendisinin yürütmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bedensel kullanımda tenlerin doğrudan değmesini; işle ilgili kullanımda ise kişinin hazır bulunup işi bizzat yürütmesini aynı aracısız katılım çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: doğrudan temas etme veya işi bizzat yürütme
concept_gloss.applicability: Kadınla ten teması ve işle kişisel ilgilenme yapılarını, ortak aracısız katılım sınırıyla birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel temas ile işi şahsen yürütme arasındaki yapı ayrımını ve doğrudanlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınla doğrudan ten teması veya cinsel yakınlaşma anlatılan yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tenlerin doğrudan değmesiyle gerçekleşen bedensel yakınlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin işin başında bulunup işi aracı kullanmadan kendisinin yürüttüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel hazır bulunuşu ve işin doğrudan üstlenilmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir erkeğin bir kadınla ten tene yakınlaşması
işin başında bizzat bulunup onu yürütme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadınla tenlerin gerçekten değmesini ve ayrıca bir işi bizzat yürütmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaklaşma, bir şeye karışma ve suçla ilişki kurma gibi daha geniş temas derecelerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kadınla cinsel yakınlık ve kişilerin birbirine yaklaşması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bedensel kullanımda gerçek ten temasını şart koşar ve işle ilgili ayrı bir yapı taşır; komşu dal yaklaşma ve karışmaya kadar genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrudan ten temasını veya bir işi şahsen yürütmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeye yaklaşmayı, eşiğine gelmeyi veya cinsel ilişkiyi dolaylı anlatımla göstermeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yakınlık, ilişki ve kadınla cinsel temas bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aracısız temas ya da kişisel yürütme gerektirir; komşu dal fiili temas gerçekleşmeden yalnızca yaklaşmayı da anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tenlerin değmesini geniş biçimde ve bir işe şahsen katılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kollarla sarılma ve bedeni kucaklayarak yanında tutma eylemine özeldir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da iki bedenin doğrudan ve yakın temasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal için herhangi bir doğrudan ten teması yeterli olabilir; komşu dal özel olarak sarılma ve kucaklamayı gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ten teması, yaklaşma ve sarılma sınırlarını en açık gösteren üç komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مباشرة المرأة بالمجامعة أو الملامسة، ومباشرة الأمر بحضوره وتوليه بنفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الخبر المفرح ولا قشر الأديم ولا إطلاق البشر على الإنسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: باشر الرجل المرأة إفضاؤه ببشرته إلى بشرتها (maqayis)؛ مباشرة الرجل المرأة لتضام أبشارهما (ayn;tahdhib)؛ مباشرة المرأة ملامستها (sihah)؛ باشر الرجل المرأة إذا ألصق بشرته ببشرتها (jamhara)؛ المباشرة الإفضاء بالبشرتين (mufradat)؛ مباشرة الأمر أن تحضره بنفسك (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri ya da işlenmiş deri yüzeyinin üst katmanını soyup alma işlemini, bu sırada düşen parçayı ve çekirgelerin yerin üzerindekileri yemesini açıkça bir araya getirir. Çekirge kullanımı yüzeyden giderme ortaklığıyla bağlı bir genişlemedir, çekirdek soyma işlemiyle eşitlenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dış katmanın kendisini değil, onu soyup alma işlemini ve yalnızca belirtilen yapıda yüzeydekilerin yenmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Soyma anlamı hem biçimde hem deriyle kurulan yapılarda görülür; çekirgelerin yüzeydekini yemesi yalnızca kendi yapısına bağlı bir genişlemedir.

concept_map.definition: Deri ya da işlenmiş deri gibi bir yüzeyin görünen üst katmanını soyarak almayı ve bu işlemde düşen parçayı anlatır. Çekirgelerle ilgili yapıda, yerin üstündekileri yiyip tüketme anlamına genişler.

facets.statement: Deri veya benzeri bir yüzeyin görünen üst katmanı soyularak alınır.
Soyma sırasında yüzeyden düşen parça, işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
Çekirgelerle kurulan yapıda, yerin üstündekilerin yenip tüketilmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar üst deri katmanının soyularak alınmasında birleşir; ayrıca soyulan parçayı sonuç olarak ve çekirgelerin yer yüzeyindekileri yemesini yüzeyden giderme genişlemesi olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: dış katmanı soyma, soyulan parça ve yüzeydekini tüketme
concept_gloss.applicability: Soyma çekirdeğini, çıkan parçayı ve yalnızca çekirge yapısındaki yüzey tüketimini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İşlemi, işlemin sonucunu ve çekirge yapısına bağlı tüketme genişlemesini ayrı tutar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri ya da işlenmiş deri yüzeyinin üst bölümünün kazınıp alındığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst katmanın yüzeyden soyularak ayrılması işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Soyma işlemi sonunda yüzeyden ayrılıp düşen parça kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlem sonucunda ortaya çıkan dış katman parçasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çekirgelerin yerdeki bitki ve benzeri yüzey unsurlarını yediği özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirge yapısına bağlı yüzey tüketimini bağlam içinde tam korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deri yüzeyini soyma sonucunu ve çekirgelerin yüzeydekini tüketmesi yapısını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyi ve özellikle balığı derisinden ya da kabuğundan çıkarma kapsamına açılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir dış katmanı nesnenin yüzeyinden ayırma işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal özellikle görünen deri katmanına ve yüzeyden tüketme genişlemesine bağlıdır; komşu dal nesne ve balık üzerinden daha genel bir soyma alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dış deri katmanının alınmasına ve yüzeydekilerin çekirgelerce tüketilmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deriyi yüzmenin yanında dal kesme ve çubuk, yay ya da kiriş çıkarma işlemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir dış katmanı kazıma veya yüzerek ayırma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yüzey derisiyle sınırlı bir soyma çekirdeği taşır; komşu dal kesme ve içinden malzeme çıkarma yönünde daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli dış katmanı soyar ve çıkan parçayı da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi kökünden yok etmeyi, bütünüyle gidermeyi ve saç ya da yağı kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeyi yüzeyden kaldırma veya giderme eylemini içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal katmanla sınırlı soyma işlemidir; komşu dal tümden yok etme ve kökünü kazıma sonucuna kadar uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; soyma işleminin nesne kapsamı, çıkarma biçimi ve tümden giderme derecesini ayıran üç komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قشر بشرة الجلد أو الأديم، وأخذ ظاهر الجلد، وأكل الجراد ما على الأرض.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه ظهور البشرة نفسها ولا مباشرة المرأة إلا من جهة اشتراك اللفظ في البشرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بشرت الأديم إذا قشرت وجهه (maqayis)؛ البشر قشرك البشرة عن الجلد (ayn)؛ بشرت الأديم إذا قشرت بشرته وبشارة الأديم ما سقط منه (jamhara)؛ بشرت الأديم إذا أخذت بشرته (sihah;tahdhib)؛ بشرت الأديم أصبت بشرته وبشر الجراد الأرض إذا أكلته (mufradat)؛ بشر الجراد الأرض إذا أكل ما عليها (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği, alıcının yüzünde sevinç uyandıran haberin verilmesi olarak kurar; haberin kendisini, haberi getireni ve alıcının sevinmesini de bu olaya bağlar. Kötü içerikli kullanım ancak içeriğin açıkça belirtilmesi veya alaycı bir tersleme bulunması koşuluyla geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Niteliksiz kullanım sevindirici habere aittir; kötü haber anlamı açık bir kötü içerik ya da alaycı tersleme olmadan genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal haber verme çekirdeğini biçimler ve yapılar boyunca taşır; kötü içerikli okuma yalnızca açıkça sınırlandırılmış yapıda, alaycı kullanım olarak geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Birine sevinç uyandıran bir haberi iletmeyi; buna bağlı olarak sevindirici haberi, haberi getireni ve haberi alanın sevinmesini anlatır. Kötü içerik ancak açıkça belirtilirse ya da alaycı bir tersleme kurulursa bu kalıpla bildirilebilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye onu sevindirecek bir haber verilir.
Sevindirici haberin kendisi ve bu haberi getiren kişi aynı haber verme olayına bağlı olarak adlandırılır.
Haberi alanın sevinmesi ve bir topluluğun karşılıklı sevindirici haber vermesi sonuç veya karşılıklılık olarak anlatılır.
Kötü içerikli bildirim yalnızca kötülük açıkça söylendiğinde veya alaycı bir tersleme yapıldığında geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, temel kullanımı sevinç veren haberin iletilmesi olarak açıklar ve haber, haberci ile alıcının sevinmesini bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Kötü içerik niteliksiz kullanıma ait değildir; açık sınırlama veya alaycı tersleme gerektirir.

concept_gloss.text: sevindirici haber verme; kötü haberde açık nitelemeli alaycı bildirim
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın olağan sevindirici haber çekirdeğini ve kötü içerik için zorunlu olan açık ya da alaycı sınırı birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Haber verme olayını, sevindirici olağan kutbu ve kötü içerikteki özel koşulu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye onu sevindirecek bir olay ya da sonuç bildirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olağan kullanımın sevindirici içerikli haber verme olayını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen haberin kendisi alıcıda sevinç uyandıran içerik olarak adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haber verme olayına bağlı sevindirici ileti içeriğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kötü sonuç açıkça söylendiğinde ve sevindirici haber kalıbı tersleyici bir alayla kullanıldığında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Kötü içeriğin açık belirtilmesi ve alaycı tersleme koşullarını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinci doğuran haber verme olayını, haberi ve haberi getireni içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir haber verme koşulu olmadan doğrudan sevinç ve coşku durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin sevinmesi ve içsel ferahlık yaşamasıyla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda sevinç bir haberin iletilmesine bağlıdır; komşu dal iletişim olayı gerektirmeyen sevinç durumunun kendisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olağan durumda alıcıyı sevindiren içerik ve bu içeriğe bağlı roller belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberin içeriğinden bağımsız olarak açıklanmasını, yayılmasını ve başkasına iletilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir haberin bir kişiden başkasına aktarılmasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal haberin sevindirici etkisini merkez alır; komşu dal değer yükü olmadan haberin duyurulması ve yayılmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinci haberin verilmesi, içeriği ve haberi getiren kişi üzerinden kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ruhsal ferahlığı, sevindiren herhangi bir neden üzerinden ve karşıt sıkıntı kutbuyla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin sevindirilmesi veya içinin ferahlaması sonucunu paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın zorunlu aracı haberdir; komşu dalda rahatlama veya sevinç başka nedenlerden de doğabilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البشارة والبشرى والتبشير والإبشار والاستبشار والبشير، أصله الخبر السار، وقد يرد بالشر إذا قيد به أو على وجه التبكيت.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النذارة المطلقة ولا مجرد حسن الوجه إلا من جهة أثر السرور فيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بشرت فلانا تبشيرا وذلك يكون بالخير وربما حمل عليه غيره من الشر (maqayis)؛ البشارة ما بشرت به والبشير المبشر بخير أو شر والبشرى الاسم (ayn;tahdhib)؛ بشرت الرجل وبشرته بما يسر به والبشرى والبشارة اسم لما بشرت به (jamhara)؛ البشارة المطلقة لا تكون إلا بالخير وإنما تكون بالشر إذا كانت مقيدة به (sihah)؛ أخبرته بسار بسط بشرة وجهه ويقال للخبر السار البشارة والبشرى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açık ve sevinçli yüz görünümünü çekirdeğe yerleştirir; buradan yüz güzelliğine ve genel olarak iyi görünüme uzanır. İnsan ve deve için kullanılan nitelemeler bu görünüş alanının örnekleridir; sevindirici haberin kendisi bu dala ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yüzün açıklığı, sevinç belirtisi ve güzel görünüşle sınırlıdır; haber verme olayı yalnızca görünüşün nedeni olabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Açık yüz ve güzellik anlamları biçimler ile belirtilen yapılara dağılır; kişi ve deve nitelemeleri kendi ad öbeklerinin sınırında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yüzün sevinçle açılıp sıcak ve hoş görünmesini, buradan da yüz güzelliğini ve iyi görünüşü anlatır. Güzel görünen erkek, kadın veya deve için kullanılan nitelemeler bu görünüş değerine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Yüz, sevinç belirtisiyle açık, sıcak ve güler bir görünüm kazanır.
Açık yüz görünümünden yüz güzelliği ve genel olarak güzel görünüş anlamına uzanır.
Erkek, kadın veya deve güzel ya da iyi görünüşlü olarak nitelenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yüzün sevinç sırasında açılıp hoş görünmesinde ve bunun güzellik ile iyi görünüşe uzanmasında birleşir; kişi ve hayvan nitelemelerini bu alanın örnekleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sevincin yüzdeki açık görünümünü, yüz güzelliğini ve buna bağlı iyi görünüş nitelemelerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Açık yüz çekirdeğini, güzellik uzantısını ve görünüş nitelemelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin yüzünün sevinçli, açık ve sıcak görünmesi kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzün sevinçle açılan hoş görünümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yüz güzelliği veya kişinin genel görünüşündeki hoşluk öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüz güzelliği ile iyi görünüş uzantısını bağlama uygun biçimde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yaradılışı ve ten rengi güzel genç kadın

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinç, açıklık ve hoşluk yüzde olumlu bir görünüm oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Öfke yüzde belirginleşen olumsuz bir iz bırakır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da içsel bir duygunun yüzde görünür bir iz bırakmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yüzün sevinçle açılan olumlu görünümünü, komşu dal ise öfkenin yüzdeki olumsuz izini gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinçli yüz açıklığını kapsar ve güzel görünüşü erkek, kadın ya da hayvan için belirtebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kadının çekici tavrını, nazını ve bu tavırla birlikte değerlendirilen güzelliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kadının hoş görünüşünü ve güzelliğini değerlendirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal güzelliği sevinçli yüz açıklığına bağlar ve kapsamı kadınla sınırlamaz; komşu dal kadınsı naz ve çekici tavrı belirleyici kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinçli yüz açıklığını ve genel hoş görünüşü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüzün dolgun, iri ve açık renkli oluşuyla tanımlanan özel bir güzellik tipidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yüzün güzel ve hoş görünmesini değerlendirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal güzelliği açık ve sevinçli görünüm üzerinden kurar; komşu dal dolgunluk, irilik ve renk gibi belirli fiziksel özelliklere bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; duygunun yüzdeki karşıt izi, toplumsal yüz açıklığı ve belirli fiziksel güzellik tipiyle sınırı gösteren üç komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حسن البشر وطلاقة الوجه والبشارة بمعنى الجمال وحسن الهيئة، والرجل أو المرأة أو الناقة البشيرة بمعنى الحسنة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخبر السار نفسه ولا البشر بمعنى الإنسان إلا إذا دل السياق على الوجه أو الهيئة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البشير الحسن الوجه والبشارة الجمال (maqayis)؛ البشارة الجمال وامرأة بشيرة (ayn)؛ البشر طلاقة الوجه وفلان حسن البشر والبشارة الجمال وحسن الهيئة (jamhara)؛ حسن البشر أي طلق الوجه والبشير الجميل وناقة بشيرة أي حسنة (sihah)؛ فلان يلقاني ببشر أي بوجه منبسط عند السرور ورجل بشير الوجه وامرأة بشيرة الوجه (tahdhib)؛ تباشير الوجه وبشره ما يبدو من سروره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sabahın ilk ışıklarını, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma belirtilerini, yağmuru haber veren rüzgârları ve bir şey tamamlanmadan beliren izleri tek bir erken görünme çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Bunlar sevindirici haberin kendisi değil, yaklaşan şeyin ön belirtileridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir şeyin erken görünen başlangıçlarını ve belirtilerini anlatır; tamamlanmış sonucu veya sırf haber verme eylemini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Erken belirti anlamı çeşitli biçim ve yapılarda gerçekleşir; sabah, hurma ve yağmur rüzgârı okumaları kendi yapılarının kapsamındadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey tamamlanmadan önce beliren ilk görünüm, iz veya belirtileri anlatır. Sabahın ilk ışıkları, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma renkleri ve yağmurun yaklaştığını bildiren rüzgârlar bu erken görünmenin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir süreç veya şey tamamlanmadan önce onun ilk görünür izleri ve başlangıçları belirir.
Sabahın gecede beliren ilk ışık yolları ve başlangıç anları bu kapsamdadır.
Hurmada olgunlaşmanın ilk renkleri ve ilk olgun ürünün görünmesi erken belirti sayılır.
Yağmuru getiren rüzgârlar, yaklaşan yağışın önceden beliren işareti olarak adlandırılır.
Rüzgârın, hayvan böğrünün veya sevinçli yüzün erken görünen izleri de aynı ilk belirti düşüncesine örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin ilk görünen başlangıçları ve tamamlanmadan önceki belirtileri olarak sunar; sabah ışığı, hurmanın ilk olgunluğu, yağmur rüzgârı ve çeşitli izleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin ilk belirtileri ve başlangıç görünümleri
concept_gloss.applicability: Tamamlanmamış bir şeyin erken izlerini ve sabah, meyve ile yağmur bağlamlarındaki özel gerçekleşmeleri kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Erken görünme çekirdeğini, başlangıç aşamasını ve yaklaşan sonuca işaret etme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gecenin içinde sabahın başladığını gösteren ilk ışık yolları anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabahın erken ve görünür ışık başlangıçlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurmada ilk renklenme veya ilk olgun ürün görünmeye başladığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Meyvenin tamamlanmadan önce görülen ilk olgunluk işaretlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgârlar yaklaşan bulut ve yağışın erken işareti olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Rüzgârların yaklaşan yağışa önceden işaret etme işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal erken belirti ve yaklaşan sonuç ilişkisini merkez alır; komşu dal ön, dış ve seçkin bölüm anlamlarına da sahiptir.
